tools.name: retrieve_runbook
tools.description: Search runbooks by keyword and return the top-k most relevant snippets. Used during Observe or Act to surface applicable remediation procedures.

query.description: Search keyword to match against runbook titles and steps

top_k.description: Maximum number of runbook snippets to return (default 3)

tools.name: run_diagnostic
tools.description: Execute a sandboxed diagnostic command on the specified host and return stdout/stderr. Supports kubectl, log-fetch, and metric queries.

command.description: Shell or kubectl command to execute in the sandbox

host.description: Target host or cluster context for the diagnostic

tools.name: summarize_incident
tools.description: Produce a 3-4 sentence triage summary for the given alert with recommended actions. Incorporates the evidence strings passed in the request.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier of the alert being summarized

evidence.description: Evidence strings or tool result references to include in the summary

tools.name: create_incident
tools.description: Create or update an incident record in memory://incidents/{id}. Returns the stored incident payload.

severity.description: Severity level: low | medium | high | critical

tools.name: add_evidence
tools.description: Append an evidence item to the memory store for later correlation and summarization.

id.description: Optional unique identifier for the evidence item

content.description: Evidence payload text or structured data

source.description: Origin of the evidence (e.g. diagnostic, runbook, manual)

tools.name: append_delta
tools.description: Append a structured action delta to memory://deltas/recent for OPAL Learn-phase replay.

action.description: Short label for the action recorded in this delta

details.description: Arbitrary key-value details associated with the action

tools.name: write_plan
tools.description: Persist the current OPAL plan to memory://plans/current for inspection and replay.

plan.description: Ordered list of OPAL step descriptors to persist

tools.name: append_memory_delta
tools.description: Append a structured memory delta capturing loop outcome to memory://deltas/recent.

delta.description: Delta payload capturing loop outcome to append to memory://deltas/recent
